rows.grounds: numeral referring to the eight powers
compound with internal sandhi joining attainment of powers and root Kaula

items.question: What constitutes the root Kaula teaching regarding the eight powers and attainment of siddhis?
premises: The eight powers are included in this teaching.
The attainment of siddhis is affirmed alongside them.
Together these are identified as the root Kaula.
items.inference: The eight powers and the attainment of siddhis together constitute the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the eight powers is not specified in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: And the eight, O fair-faced one, and the attainment of siddhis—this is the root Kaula.
